usages.explain:
✦ Carries the meaning of 「非常にうまく」"extremely well," 「みごとに」"excellently."
✦ Used in contexts of successfully deceiving others or using cunning methods that are not commendable.
✦ When used in the passive form 「まんまとV－された」, it expresses the speaker's resignation or surprise at being cunningly deceived.

examples.content: やつにまんまと騙された。
examples.transcription: やつにまんまとだまされた。
examples.mean: I was totally fooled by that guy.

examples.content: まんまと、してやられた。
examples.transcription: まんまと、してやられた。

examples.content: 犯人は、金をだまし取ることにまんまと成功した。
examples.transcription: はんにんは、きんをだましとることにまんまとせいこうした。
examples.mean: The culprit was completely successful in stealing the money.

usages.synopsis: ✦まんまと + V (The action is performed very skillfully and easily)

usages.explain: ✦ (Note) After 「まんまと」, usually only a few verbs with idiomatic connotations are used, such as 「騙す」(to deceive), 「してやる」(to trick), 「一杯くわせる」(to cheat), 「忍び込む」(to sneak in).

title: まんまと => successfully, fairly, artfully, nicely, thoroughly
